title: Velociraptor call (sound design from real animal recordings)
author: DigiZoo sound design from recordings by U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service; The user Felix.Blume https://freesound.org/people/felix.blume/; G. McGrane
changes: Movie-style dinosaur call: no recordings of dinosaurs exist, so it was designed from real animal recordings (honking geese, screaming dolphins and a hissing turkey vulture, pitched and layered). Sound design from 3 real recordings: "Geese Honking (loud)" 1.38–2.62 s, high-passed at 300 Hz, slowed to 0.85× speed (pitched down 15%); "161691 felixblume dolphin-screaming-underwater-in-caribbean-sea-mexico" 3.45–4.20 s, high-passed at 800 Hz, slowed to 0.8× speed (pitched down 20%), placed at 0.55 s; "Turkey Vulture" 18.45–19.00 s, slowed to 0.9× speed (pitched down 10%), placed at 1.35 s; then mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 150 Hz, added reverb, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
